openingMessages.text: I had dinner with our biggest enterprise prospect last night. They want SSO, audit logs, and role-based permissions. Q3.
Q3 is six weeks away. We're still working through the performance backlog.
Those are non-trivial features. SSO alone is a multi-week project, and that's before we account for the current state of the codebase.
I don't want to hear about debt. I need to hear about dates.

choices.label: We'll make it happen
choices.subtext: Yes to everything. Full speed ahead.
choices.tagline: Made the promise. Started the clock.

followUpMessages.text: That's what I like to hear. 🔥 I'll let the prospect know.
...I'm going to need help. And coffee. A lot of coffee.
I'll update the roadmap. And quietly adjust my own expectations.

choices.label: Let's talk about scope
choices.subtext: We can do some of it. Let's prioritize.

followUpMessages.text: I need all three. Not two.
We can deliver SSO and audit logs in Q3. Role permissions is a Q4 item — and it'll be done properly.
Fine. But I'm holding you to Q3 for the first two. The prospect is watching.

choices.label: Fast-track with shortcuts
choices.subtext: We'll build it fast. Some compromises required.

followUpMessages.text: Excellent. I'll announce it to the prospect.
We'll hardcode some of the permission logic. It's... fine for now. I think.
